idea: PlagaNet is a mobile app that gives Peruvian potato and corn farmers instant, offline pest diagnosis from a photo, using computer vision trained on local data. It addresses the costly habit of guesswork or delayed expert visits by providing actionable recommendations in seconds, even without connectivity. The freemium model offers free basic diagnosis, with premium features for monitoring and advice, while a B2G module enables Agrorural to track pest outbreaks across regions by aggregating anonymized farmer data.

idea: PlagaNet for B2B is an offline-first pest diagnosis and monitoring platform that agricultural cooperatives and input distributors purchase to empower their member farmers with instant AI-powered identification of potato and corn pests using smartphone photos. The platform integrates a centralized dashboard that aggregates real-time pest outbreak data from all member fields, enabling the buyer to provide proactive, localized support, optimize input distribution, and reduce crop loss across their network. The buyer pays a per-member or per-hectare subscription fee, turning the service into a value-add that strengthens loyalty and improves supply chain quality.
